chunks: And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
Whoever trims from his nails every Thursday, his child will not suffer from eye inflammation.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far, the title of Imam Muḥammad ibn ‘Alī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.أَخَذَ: took or trimmed, here referring to cutting the nails
key_terms.يَرْمَدْ: to suffer from eye inflammation or an eye ailment

ai.seo_question: What is narrated from Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام about trimming the nails on Thursday?
ai.summary: Imam Muḥammad ibn ‘Alī al-Bāqir عليه السلام teaches a practice of personal grooming tied to wellbeing within one's family. The hadith presents trimming the nails on Thursday as a recommended act associated with protection from eye ailment for one's child.
